title: AIDS control staff to begin statewide agitation today

ai.summary: Punjab AIDS Control Employees Welfare Association (PACEWA) employees announced a statewide agitation starting November 23, demanding a 20% salary hike and other benefits, with plans to stop uploading patient reports and boycott work from November 25.

facts.claim: Punjab AIDS Control Employees Welfare Association (PACEWA) employees announced a statewide agitation starting November 23
facts.quote: employees of the Punjab AIDS Control Employees Welfare Association (PACEWA) have announced a statewide agitation from November 23

facts.claim: demanding a 20% salary hike and other benefits
facts.quote: Besides the salary hike, the association is demanding implementation of health insurance, release of pending arrears, resolution of transfer related issues, clearance of various allowances.

facts.claim: plans to stop uploading patient reports and boycott work from November 25
facts.quote: employees will stop uploading daily patient reports on the SOCH portal from November 23 and completely boycott work from November 25

ai.background_note: Punjab AIDS Control Employees Welfare Association (PACEWA) employees are demanding a 20% salary hike and other benefits after repeated assurances from the Health Department failed to resolve their issues.
